name: tsa-azure-devops
description: Azure DevOps extension for Terrible Settings Auditor (TSA): a pipeline task that screens configuration and a build results tab that displays tsa-report.json.

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:task && npm run build:task-deps && npm run build:tab
scripts.package: npm run build && tfx extension create --manifest-globs vss-extension.json --output-path out
scripts.package:dev: npm run build && tfx extension create --manifest-globs vss-extension.json --output-path out --rev-version
